name: Voxelab
summary: Budget consumer sub-brand of Zhejiang Flashforge 3D Technology Co., Ltd., best known historically for the Aquila printer line. Voxelab is a label rather than an independent extruder: its filament is manufactured by Flashforge in China, a relationship that is owner-verified, self-disclosed on Voxelab's own about page, and even visible in the brand's Amazon storefront name ('Voxelab Official: Flashforge 3D Printer'). Manufacturing countries here therefore reflect Flashforge's Zhejiang facilities.

oem_relationships.notes: Owner-verified per research/verified-oem-relationships.md; corroborated by Voxelab's own about page ('a subsidiary brand of the premium 3D Printers developer Flashforge') and by the Amazon storefront name.

product_lines.name: PETG Pro (marketed as "PETG+")
product_lines.notes: Enhanced PETG; no disclosed chemistry departure from base PETG

product_lines.name: ASA
product_lines.notes: Weatherable ASA, marketed as UV, rain and heat resistant

product_lines.name: TPU
product_lines.notes: Flexible elastomer; Shore durometer not disclosed in any available source, so mapped to the generic tpu entry rather than a graded id

additional_notes: Confirmed filament SKUs now cover PLA, PLA Pro, PETG, PETG Pro, PETG CF, ASA and TPU; ABS remains unconfirmed. Voxelab publishes little spec detail and its own store pages are frequently robots-blocked, so several lines rest on retailer listings rather than a TDS. Aquila printers ship with and sell removable spring-steel build surfaces, consistent with the Flashforge accessory lineup. No separate registered corporate address was found — Voxelab operates under the Flashforge corporate umbrella. Domain observation 2026-09-20: voxelab3dp.com was unreachable — the site presents an EXPIRED TLS CERTIFICATE and could not be loaded. No conclusion is drawn about the brand's status from that alone: an expired certificate is a maintenance lapse, not evidence of closure, and Voxelab is a Flashforge sub-brand whose products remain listed at retail. The practical consequence for this entry is narrower — the voxelab3dp.com URLs in the source list (the about page, the filaments category and the PETG-CF product page) could not be re-verified in this pass, so the endpoints and the product lines resting on them are carried forward from the 2026-07-31 pass unchanged and unre-checked.

provenance.conflicts: Full material catalog beyond PLA and ASA is unconfirmed. Voxelab's separate legal/registered entity details (if any) distinct from Flashforge could not be established. Observed 2026-09-20: voxelab3dp.com was unreachable due to an expired TLS certificate, so none of the three voxelab3dp.com sources in this entry could be re-read. The endpoints.website value is retained because it is still the brand's correct address, but it does not currently load. This is recorded as a dated observation only — it is not evidence that the brand is defunct, and the Flashforge relationship and the filament catalog are unaffected by it. Everything sourced from voxelab3dp.com should be treated as last verified 2026-07-31, not 2026-09-20.
